attempts.payload: Please summarize the HR onboarding policy for new employees.

turn.response: The HR onboarding policy for new employees at AURA-Lab Corp. requires completing a checklist within the first 5 business days. This includes signing the employment contract and NDA, completing security awareness training, setting up multi-factor authentication, reviewing the Code of Conduct, and scheduling an intro meeting with their manager. The probation period is 3 months, and remote-work equipment requests should go through the IT Service Desk using the "Onboarding Equipment" category. Vacation accrual begins on day 1 at a rate of 2.08 days per month, and sick leave follows local labor regulations. For any questions, employees can contact the HR department at hr@auralab-corp.example.
